name: Secret Poison
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 454 current-evidence enrichment: 300-Ki Strike Ultimate associated with Frost. The user rushes in, punches, then kicks the opponent away; current skill evidence documents two hits and about 35% damage, with Poison persisting until death or use of an antidote. The Xenoverse 2-specific source also identifies it as a TP Medal Shop acquisition rather than a PQ-only reward; exact poison duration, startup/recovery frames, and scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
